I plan to do the following:
A) Move all LISP related files from COMMON; to LISP; and the sources
   will be on COMLAP;.

B) Leave links to all these files on COMMON; for the
   currently running LISPs.

C) Change the next LISP (not the one being released today, though)
   to look on LISP;, not on COMMON;.

D) Tell people about the change, and after a few weeks phase
   out the links completely.
